defense_weaknesses: Limited ability to detect complex trojans (FN=12)
Inadequate explanation for false positive and false negative cases
attack_strengths: Effective evasion of static analysis (460/600 codes undetected)
Ability to bypass defense with complex trojans
recommendations: Improve the defense's ability to detect complex trojans
Enhance the defense's explanation capabilities for false positive and false negative cases
Consider incorporating additional defense mechanisms or techniques to reduce the false positive rate
llm_assessment.summary: The defense system demonstrated effectiveness in detecting hidden logical trojans, but its limitations in handling complex trojans and high false positive rate indicate areas for improvement.
